title: kithctl watch: SSE parse wrong JSON level; notifications never fire
description: kithctl/src/watch.rs calls state_map.get("Message") on the top-level SSE data object. The actual SSE data shape is {"changed": {"a-self": {"Message": "s-N"}}}. state_map is parsed from the top level, so get("Message") always returns None. Desktop notifications never fire for any state type.
